title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, September 29 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Bulker S&P values held stable across the board this week. Handy resales drifted downwardsin response to soft pricing for the Sider Bellezza. Capesize Houheng 5 and Houheng 6 (262,000 DWT, Feb/Sep 2017, Guangzhou Shipyard International) sold to an undisclosed buyer for USD 144 mil, VV Value USD 151.28 mil.
